components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, every non-digit
            character is stripped and the result must be exactly 10 digits;
            the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. The value is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-16'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner

## Summary

I changed telephone handling so numbers are stored in E.164 form. The work spanned three layers:

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.normalizeTelephone`** — rewrote the normalization:
- Strips spaces, dashes and brackets.
- If the input has a leading `+`, that `+` and country code are kept as-is.
- Otherwise country code `+61` is assumed and a single leading `0` is dropped from the national digits.
- Requires 8–15 digits after the `+`, else throws `InvalidTelephoneException` → **400**.
- e.g. `0412 345 678` → `+61412345678`, `+64 21 123 456` → `+6421123456`, `12` → rejected.

**Duplicate detection (`rejectDuplicateTelephone`)** — now normalizes each existing owner's telephone to E.164 (via a new `toE164OrNull` helper that swallows invalid stored values) and compares E.164 strings, so national and international forms of the same number collide → **409**. Also applied normalization in `updateOwner` for consistency with the entity constraint.

**`Owner` entity** — replaced the old `@Digits(integer=10)` + `^[0-9]{10}$` constraints with `@Pattern("^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$")` so persisted E.164 values pass Bean Validation. Removed the now-unused `@Digits` import.

**Docs** — updated `InvalidTelephoneException`'s message/javadoc and the OpenAPI `telephone` description + example to describe the E.164 behaviour.

All 16 acceptance tests pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`), including the new Cp02/Cp03/Cp08 E.164 checks and the existing Cp01 blank-telephone rejection.
